description: Construction of a two storey side extension including relocation of the side entrance door to the front of the dwelling
decision_conditions:
<div>The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition, representing an overly dominant and disproportionate extension to the dwelling.&nbsp; The side extension would sit uncomfortably to the side of the host dwelling, significantly impacting the character of the terrace dwelling and failing to appear as subordinate. The side extension would be significantly visible form public vantage points and would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and would be out of character in the context of the area.&nbsp; As such,&nbsp; the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area, including the historic distinctiveness of the Becontree Estate. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design whilst protecting and enhancing historic environments:&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><div><p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">-

London Plan (March 2021)</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- The Residential
